limits: BIMI certificate retrieval remains opt-in.
Certificate identity is not an ownership verdict.
renderer_obligations: Retain opt-in probe scope and never promote certificate identity into legal ownership.
runtime.bimi-observation.v1.subject_scope: queried public namespace and explicitly fetched BIMI material

limits: Catalog matches are probabilistic classifications.
Per-slug levels are evidence-strength tiers, not truth probabilities.
renderer_obligations: Use indicator or observed-record language; never imply current product use, deployment, or control.
runtime.catalog-indicator.v1.subject_scope: queried public namespace and exact public record occurrence

limits: Ephemeral changes are process-local.
Re-evaluation is cache-only unless reload clears cached lookup results.
renderer_obligations: State network and cache behavior exactly; separate local mutation from target observations.
runtime.catalog-operation.v1.subject_scope: local recon process and operator-owned catalog state

limits: Compatibility projections do not retain every per-query observation opportunity.
No degraded marker does not prove globally complete collection.
renderer_obligations: Mask unavailable channels, retain degraded markers, and distinguish empty observation from unavailable collection.
runtime.collection-status.v1.subject_scope: one bounded collection attempt for the queried public namespace

limits: Evidence confidence counts distinct useful sources.
Inference confidence is scoped to the winning canonical claim.
renderer_obligations: Call tiers deterministic summaries, not calibrated probabilities or confidence in every field.
runtime.confidence-summary.v1.subject_scope: merged output and its same-claim contributing source results

limits: Overlap does not establish ownership, shared control, a business relationship, or current use.
Absence of an optional public token is non-informative.
renderer_obligations: Name the exact token, tenant-ID, display-label, issuer, provider, or slug overlap and keep alternative explanations open.

limits: CT can contain stale or historical names.
Community detection is a heuristic over co-issuance, not an ownership model.
renderer_obligations: Describe certificate co-issuance and bounded counts; never infer ownership or active hosting.
runtime.ct-observation.v1.subject_scope: certificate SANs associated with the queried public namespace under bounded CT collection

limits: A delta compares two snapshots of the same queried namespace and does not explain why a value changed.
Unavailable collection channels suppress affected comparisons rather than becoming removals.
renderer_obligations: Report only observed snapshot differences, surface incomplete comparisons, and make no causal claim.
runtime.delta-report.v1.subject_scope: two time-stamped snapshots of one normalized public namespace coordinate

limits: Federation branding can differ from a legal entity.
The queried domain is the fallback label.
renderer_obligations: Label it as public display metadata and never as a verified legal organization name.
runtime.display-label.v1.subject_scope: best public display label returned for the queried namespace

limits: Empty DNS remains unresolved without authority or authenticated-denial provenance.
The count is not an overall security score and controls are not equally weighted.
renderer_obligations: Describe email_security_score as a count of observable public controls; state bounded selector scope for DKIM and observation scope for empty DNS.
runtime.email-control-observation.v1.subject_scope: email-control records at the queried apex and documented bounded selectors

limits: A provider indicator does not establish mailbox routing.
A gateway can hide the downstream mailbox provider.
renderer_obligations: Distinguish MX delivery path, MX gateway, DKIM-supported downstream provider, and weaker non-MX indicators.
The default view may compact the record role per ADR-0012 but retains the hedges that bound the claim: likely downstream, downstream unobserved, and no supporting record.
runtime.email-topology.v1.subject_scope: public mail routing and provider indicators for the queried apex

limits: Schema-version-1 provenance_complete retains its stable graph-reachability meaning; exact_provenance_complete is the stronger exact-lineage diagnostic.
An exact_rule_only terminal retains its emitting rule but remains lineage-disconnected because raw support is absent or incomplete.
Exact lineage records currently retain exactly one emitter ID; multiple rule IDs are rejected because the record does not encode a per-rule evidence partition.
Legacy caller-supplied insight strings and proxy-matched posture observations remain explicitly reconstructed and lineage-disconnected.
renderer_obligations: Report each terminal as exact, exact-rule-only, reconstructed, or unsupported; preserve schema-version-1 reachability fields; and list every terminal without an exact evidence-to-rule path in lineage_disconnected_terminals.
runtime.explanation-provenance.v1.subject_scope: one rendered signal, insight, posture observation, or confidence terminal

limits: The index is not overall security, maturity, certification, or a prediction.
Quiet public channels can produce a low floor.
The compatibility scale is 0-100 while the current documented component model assigns 90 maximum points.
Hypothetical simulation components are labeled as hypothetical values rather than live observations.
renderer_obligations: Call the compatibility value a model-bound public-evidence index and report its exact-evidence floor, bounded ceiling, unavailable controls, weighted component ledger, and retained evidence.
Preserve stable posture_score names while exposing additive component, rule, state, predicate, scope, and evidence fields; label simulation-only values as hypothetical.
runtime.exposure-index.v1.subject_scope: controls observable in recon's public-evidence model for one queried namespace

limits: Exact lineage covers the bounded insight-generator family, not signal, conflict, lexical, or posture text produced elsewhere.
Absence-shaped insights record canonical bounded observation scopes; unknown scopes and every declared unavailable opportunity fail closed during collection projection.
Positive catalog and service claims require a retained, role-specific supporting occurrence; unscoped related-namespace inventory is withheld even when the queried namespace retained no evidence.
Related-namespace inventory is excluded from queried-namespace declarative-signal and sparse-result inputs.
Degraded results persist only the claims whose declared scopes remained observable, including when CT enrichment was incomplete.
Result-cache versions before v4 are invalidated, and v4 reads and writes reject missing, duplicate, or inconsistent generated-insight associations without allowing cache failures to escape.
renderer_obligations: Attach the exact generator rule ID and supporting retained evidence or bounded observation scope to every emitted insight.
runtime.generated-insight.v1.subject_scope: queried public namespace and the projected inputs consumed by one named generator

limits: A recommendation is not a vulnerability verdict.
An empty evidence array proves no absence by itself; bounded non-observations require a named successful observation scope and a satisfied typed predicate.
DKIM non-observation covers only recon's common-selector set and remains an unresolved hideable state.
Observed weak configurations and compound inconsistencies are withheld unless their role-bearing public-record evidence is retained and agrees with the derived scalar state.
Observed invalid or ambiguous DMARC material produces an evidence-backed review prompt with a distinct invalid or ambiguous basis rather than being mislabeled as record absence or silently discarded.
MTA-STS DNS activation and HTTP policy retrieval are separate observation scopes; the HTTP scope is claimed only after a valid TXT declaration activates that request.
Simulation replaces affected evidence with internally consistent hypothetical records before re-evaluating guidance.
renderer_obligations: Separate observed weak configuration, successful bounded non-observation, and unresolved hideable state; recommendations remain neutral review prompts.
runtime.hardening-guidance.v1.subject_scope: public configuration observed for one queried namespace

limits: Keyword matching selects relevant evidence families.
Results do not confirm active use or organizational intent.
renderer_obligations: Report supporting and contradicting observations, missing evidence, collection limits, and no causal or organizational conclusion.
runtime.hypothesis-assessment.v1.subject_scope: operator-supplied theory compared with public evidence for one queried namespace

limits: Tenant discovery can be incomplete.
Missing sovereignty metadata stays unknown.
renderer_obligations: Treat tenant IDs, auth responses, tenant-domain strings, regions, and cloud metadata as namespace observations, not organization identity or ownership.
runtime.identity-and-tenant.v1.subject_scope: identity-discovery response for the queried public namespace

limits: The network is manually encoded and partly development-corpus-informed.
Missing hideable evidence remains unresolved rather than a private-state negative.
renderer_obligations: Call outputs model-relative posteriors and evidence-responsive display bands; never calibrated probabilities, credible intervals, or confidence intervals.
runtime.inference-diagnostics.v1.subject_scope: the shipped model and retained evidence units for one queried namespace

limits: String shape is contextual metadata only.
Lexical categories do not establish a running application.
renderer_obligations: Call results lexical observations, not service confirmations or ownership evidence.
runtime.lexical-diagnostic.v1.subject_scope: lexical shape of public subdomain strings

limits: Default normalization reduces a valid sub-host to the registrable apex.
Exact mode retains the literal validated host.
renderer_obligations: Call the apex a queried namespace or domain, never a company or legal entity.

limits: The default panel intentionally omits raw evidence detail.
The explanation surface must expose any unavailable direct path.
The multi-cloud row is a panel-only summary of observable endpoint-binding evidence and attributed public subdomains.
renderer_obligations: Every displayed fact must retain the same scope and evidence semantics as its canonical structured field.
Identify the panel subject with queried_domain; label a differing tenant default domain explicitly only on surfaces that show it.
Never let raw evidence from an unavailable collection channel establish a derived panel fact.
Project default_domain back to queried_domain whenever Autodiscover collection is unavailable.
runtime.panel-assembly.v1.subject_scope: default human-readable summary for the queried public namespace

limits: Metadata-only and profile-relative observations retain exact typed dependencies but remain exact-rule-only in the explanation graph because no raw evidence occurrence exists.
Legacy observations without an emitter identity remain reconstructed, and sourced observations with incomplete retained support fail closed to exact-rule-only.
Profile baseline expectations are relative lenses, not scores or universal recommendations, and are withheld when collection is degraded.
Posture rule names are unique across the combined built-in and custom catalog; the first definition wins, later collisions are skipped, and the synthetic profile namespace is reserved.
renderer_obligations: Attach the exact posture rule and its branch-local retained evidence plus typed metadata dependencies; keep profile effects as lenses, not scores.
Preserve the stable four-field public posture shape while carrying internal proof state into optional explanations.
runtime.posture-observation.v1.subject_scope: public evidence evaluated by one named posture rule

limits: CT and DNS history can be stale.
Related names are namespace breadcrumbs, not a corporate graph.
renderer_obligations: Name the exact breadcrumb or co-occurrence relation and never promote it into ownership, subsidiary, shared-control, or current-use claims.
runtime.related-namespace.v1.subject_scope: public names connected by bounded CT, CNAME, Exchange/identity endpoint, autodiscover, DKIM tenant-domain, or SAN co-occurrence breadcrumbs

limits: Legacy or externally constructed TenantInfo objects can carry service names without retained matching evidence.
A catalog name alone does not establish a role.
The default view omits unattributed matches rather than rendering them bare, so it is not a complete enumeration of catalog matches; --full and the JSON record are.
renderer_obligations: Qualify TXT account indicators, MX delivery paths, CAA authorizations, and endpoint bindings; unknown roles stay unavailable.
Evidence surfaces (--explain, --verbose, --full, JSON, MCP) carry the full role qualifier; the default view may compact it per ADR-0012, but must never imply a role it did not establish.
runtime.service-label.v1.subject_scope: one catalog match and the role established by its retained public record type

limits: Schema presence does not make a field value true.
The surface inventory is a non-contractual discovery map.
renderer_obligations: Preserve v2 field compatibility and add only versioned, reviewed semantics.
runtime.structured-transport.v1.subject_scope: stable JSON and local MCP transport contract

limits: Guidance is a consumer contract, not target evidence.
Client-specific installation details can change independently of runtime semantics.
renderer_obligations: Mirror runtime scope, target-interaction boundaries, output semantics, cache behavior, and abstention rules without stronger claims.
static.agent-guidance.v1.subject_scope: shipped agent guidance and installation documentation

limits: Tool descriptions describe behavior; returned target claims require their runtime evidence paths.
The transport is local stdio by default.
renderer_obligations: Every description states scope, side effects, network behavior, and evidentiary limits accurately.
static.mcp-contract.v1.subject_scope: local stdio MCP tool behavior and agent-facing descriptions

coverage_contract.surface_digest_algorithm: sha256(sorted UTF-8 surface IDs joined by LF)

purpose: Fail-closed taxonomy for every material default panel, JSON, MCP, agent-guidance, recommendation, and score surface. Coverage entries name the claim family that owns each discovered surface; family records state the direct implementation and evidence path, renderer duties, tests, and known limits.
scope: Default and primary local product surfaces only. Opt-in experimental validation artifacts are out of scope unless they feed a listed default surface.
subject_rule: The subject is a queried public namespace coordinate. No entry may silently promote it into an organization, owner, operator, account holder, or current product user.
